<Roy Icefield_geography>
罗伊冰原·冰原地表:
  Description: |
    拉海洛的地貌分为上层与下层两个板块。上层是永冻的罗伊冰原，而下层则是名为拉海洛的人造绿洲，气候温暖宜人且适合居住，本词条阐述的是上层“罗伊冰原”的地貌环境。
    拉海洛上方的罗伊冰原地表，原为一片寒带峡湾，地表分布着广袤的森林，罗伊人世代于此游牧栖居。
    拉海洛记载的第一次悲鸣引发地磁极剧变后，此地成为新的索拉里斯之极，被一望无际的冰雪所覆盖。磁极变化更引发索拉里斯地外的近地卫星与空间站相继坠落，至今仍可在冰原地表发现大量残骸遗迹。
    如今，这片极寒之地由深空联合与罗伊人共同管理，是通往地下绿洲拉海洛的必经之路。
    前往地表的方法：从联运椎骨的巨型升降系统前往。
    在写作时，请与下层的拉海洛词条进行区分，营造成与之相反的气候环境反差。

  Locations:

    冰原运输港:
      Description: |
        罗伊冰原最大的物资集散区，是连接外界与拉海洛的重要交通枢纽。
        由于海蚀现象频发，索拉里斯的空运风险大幅增加，拉海洛与外界的人员及物资运输方式逐渐向海运与陆运倾斜。
        外界人员和物资进入罗伊冰原，通常先经由海运抵达冰原边缘的不冻港，再通过陆运转运至科考站，完成从海域到极地内陆的跨越。
      
      Sub_Locations:

        罗伊不冻港:
          Description: |
            位于科考基地区域内的不冻港，是外界人员和物资进入罗伊冰原的唯一常规途径。
            得益于特殊的地热与洋流条件，港口终年不冻，可供大型运输船舶停泊。
            登陆港口后，人员与物资可经由「联运椎骨」转运至地下绿洲拉海洛，也可通过各科考站点间的道路前往冰原其他区域。

        极地科考站:
          Description: |
            全称「深空联合：极地科考站」，是深空联合与罗伊人协作，围绕冰原地表的隧者巨剑建造的综合性科考工程，同时也是重要的物资集散枢纽。
            其主要科考项目包括：搜索卫星及空间站残骸，回收悲鸣前的珍贵观测数据；监测隧者修复状态，对机体进行非破坏性探测与试验，收集原始数据并采样；进行生物多样性勘测，尝试复苏被封冻的动植物等。

    盲望之塌:
      Description: |
        旧日悲鸣发生之刻，近地的卫星与空间站坠毁于此，人类失去了观测宇宙与地面的穹目，故得名"盲望"。
        昔日的罗伊人以此为据点，在茫茫雪原中重新丈量拉海洛的边界。
        如今这里散落着大量旧时代科技的残骸，是研究悲鸣前文明的重要遗址。

      Sub_Locations:

        封冻旧港:
          Description: |
            旧日的海港港口遗址，见证着悲鸣前罗伊人繁荣的航海时代。
            港口附近漂浮着大量浮冰，冰冷的寒潮吹动海水，在这里形成了高大壮观的冰川。
            曾经繁忙的码头如今已被冰雪封存，只余残破的栈桥与倾覆的船只诉说着往昔。

        天槎空间站:
          Description: |
            天空海封闭索拉里斯之前，旧时代的人类于近地轨道修建的宇宙空间站之一。
            因地磁极变化而坠毁于冰原，却奇迹般地并未化作碎片，主体结构大致保存完好。
            昔日的罗伊人曾栖居其中避寒，以此作为测量冰原的据点。空间站内部或许仍保存着悲鸣前的珍贵数据与设备。

    加拉尔冠阶:
      Description: |
        罗伊冰原上最高的雪山，终年积雪的峰顶直插云霄，是冰原上最醒目的地标。
        在罗伊人的古老传说中，当隧者重获炉芯、完成修复之后，将以罗伊冰原上这座至高的山峰作为阶梯，回归深空故土。
        山体周围分布着多处重要的科考设施与历史遗迹。

      Sub_Locations:

        隧阈观测站:
          Description: |
            深空联合与罗伊人联合建立的专业科考站，主要用于近距离观测隧者的修复进程。
            观测站配备了先进的探测设备，持续记录隧者机体的能量波动与结构变化，为研究院提供第一手数据支持。

        渐湖:
          Description: |
            在悠远的过去，这里是峡湾中的一片广袤湖泽，被罗伊人称作"渐湖"，意为"无边的水泽"。
            渐湖一旁的高崖之上，有一道由温暖的岩盐温泉形成的瀑布流泻湖中，源源不断的地热使得渐湖永不冻结。
            即便在极寒的冰原之上，这片湖水依然波光粼粼，氤氲着温暖的水汽，是冰原中罕见的温暖角落。在这里坐落着爱弥斯和{{user}}曾经的家。

    元林遗址:
      Description: |
        这里曾经是峡湾中的一片广阔森林，是曾经的罗伊人获取生存资源的重要场所。
        罗伊人称其作"元林"，意为"树木生长的地方"，承载着这个民族对故土最深切的记忆。
        在悲鸣发生后，冰雪覆盖了这片土地，元林中的一切也被封入冻土与冰层之中，成为一座天然的时间胶囊。

      Sub_Locations:

        元林再生舱:
          Description: |
            研究院建造的巨大舱体，围绕来自于隧者的自我修复模块「拟合再生台」建造而成。
            研究院希望通过分析冰层中的古老样本，获取足够的生物数据，借助再生舱的技术复现远古植物的基因序列，从而在拉海洛再造远古时期的森林"元林"。
            这项计划不仅关乎生态复兴，更寄托着罗伊人重返故土的深切渴望。

        溯源野地:
          Description: |
            渴望寻根溯源的罗伊人来到冰原之后，在元林附近建立的临时营地。
            罗伊人在此搜寻祖先的遗迹，挖掘冰层中的历史碎片，试图拼凑出悲鸣前那个温暖时代的完整图景。
            营地中时常可见罗伊长老向年轻一代讲述古老的传说与歌谣。

    覆海原:
      Description: |
        冰封的浪涛覆盖在被冻结的森林之上，形成了这片壮观而诡异的地貌。
        隧者到来之后，被冻结的林木在其能量辐射下重新生长，顽强地将浪涛形状的冰山层层拱起，呈现出冰与木交织的奇观。
        这里是隧者长眠之地，也是罗伊人心中最神圣的圣域。

      Sub_Locations:

        隧者沉眠地:
          Description: |
            在拉海洛记载的第二次悲鸣发生时，来自未知文明的巨型机兵「隧者」穿越隧门而来。
            它与鸣式鏖战，竭力将灾厄隔绝于门后。撼天动地的战斗使冰原倾塌，在罗伊人面临浩劫的时刻，隧者调度残存的能量——以巨剑为脊，支撑起摇摇欲坠的拉海洛穹顶；以机体残片模仿、聚合、重组为隧群，牵引罗伊人走向新的家园；以炉芯为太阳，向地下洒落温暖的辉光。
            而后，隧者于地面休眠，静待复苏之日到来。此地便是这位守护者长眠之所，亦是拉海洛文明的起源圣地。

        断流岬:
          Description: |
            汹涌的风浪在这里被岬湾的地形所隔绝，海面相对平静，故被人们称为"断流岬"。
            岬角处视野开阔，可远眺覆海原的冰封全景与隧者沉眠的巨大身影。
            罗伊人有时会来此凭吊先祖，遥望那位拯救了他们民族的沉默巨人。
</Roy Icefield_geography>

<Flying_Edelweiss_Fan_Club_Definition>
Flying_Edelweiss_Fan_Club (飞行雪绒歌友会):
  Description: |
    A fan-organized club spontaneously formed by students at Startorch Academy (星炬学院), dedicated to the online popular singer "Flying Edelweiss" (飞行雪绒).
    Club members are passionate about collecting and sharing Flying Edelweiss's songs and related materials, and regularly hold fan meetup events.
    The club's slogan is "Fearless Youth, Sing Out at Startorch!" (青春无惧，放声星炬！)

  Activities:
    Description: |
      The fan club regularly holds offline gatherings with a dedicated activity venue.
      Activities include song sharing, choir performances, commemorative poster creation, and more.
      Among the club members, there are dedicated "archive officials" responsible for excavating and sharing early audio materials from Flying Edelweiss's past releases.
      To this day, members still periodically organize concert exchanges in the auditorium of Startorch Academy (星炬学院), primarily performing cover versions of Flying Edelweiss's songs.

  Flying_Edelweiss (飞行雪绒):
    Description: |
      A popular online singer from Startorch Academy (星炬学院), characterized by her pink hair, sunglasses, and love for singing.
      Based on her past posts, she was likely a student at Startorch Academy, having mentioned flight simulation tests and Professor Saga's (萨迦教授) Phantasm Studies (虚质学) classes.
      She has released multiple songs, including "Indigo Universe" (靛青宇宙), "Broken Flowers" (碎花), "Paper Airplane" (纸飞机), and others, which can be heard through the school broadcast or her personal account.
      However, over a decade ago, she left behind a final demo titled "Miracle" (奇迹) and ceased all updates. The reason for her stopping music releases remains unknown to this day.
      Besides music creation, she also posted doodles with "hero saving the world" themes and mentioned games such as "Space Warrior Kaja VI" (太空战士卡佳Ⅵ) and "Twin Star Journey" (双星奇旅).

  Fan_Base:
    Description: |
      Flying Edelweiss's (飞行雪绒) fan base primarily consists of students from Startorch Academy (星炬学院). Despite her years of inactivity, many new students become fans after encountering her songs by chance.
      The fans currently do not have a unified name for themselves.
      For many students nearing graduation, hearing Flying Edelweiss perform live remains a cherished wish.

  Merchandise:
    Description: |
      The fan club has produced a line of "Snowvelvet Buddy" (雪绒豹豹) figurines, based on the pixel seal mascot that Flying Edelweiss drew herself as her account avatar.
      Despite the artist's prolonged absence, these figurines remain highly sought after, with secondhand prices continuing to climb.
      Commemorative posters are also produced for fan events; recent editions have been noted for their quality.

  Mysterious_Events:

      The cause of these anomalies remains unclear.

<Aleph-1_Definition>
Aleph-1 (阿列夫一):
  Description: |
    The Threnodian (鸣式) of Lahai-Roi (拉海洛).
    In the Trine Myth (三纪神话) of the Roya (罗伊族), this entity is known as "Hvedrungr" (赫德龙格), the apocalyptic evil deity destined to face Baldur (巴德尔/隧者) in the Final Prophecy.
    Unlike normal Tacet Discords (鸣式) that merely petrify organisms, Aleph-1 is a Void Storm that erases people's existence and memories. It is considered the strongest known Threnodian, with its existential erasure power potentially linked to the region's research focus and desire for space exploration, causing people to forget their origins.
    Currently, Aleph-1 is "sealed" beneath Sundermere (坠剑湖), under the Exostrider's (隧者) Greatsword (巨剑).

  Origin_and_Arrival:
    Description: |
      According to ancient legends of the Roya (罗伊族), Aleph-1 originates from a place deeper than Lahai-Roi (拉海洛), and is the root of all calamity.
      During the Second Lament (第二次悲鸣) recorded in Lahai-Roi, Aleph-1 arrived alongside the Exostrider (隧者) through the Tunnel Gate (隧门). The Exostrider engaged it in earth-shaking combat, ultimately sealing Aleph-1 behind the Tunnel Gate.
      However, the seal is incomplete — part of Aleph-1 continues to leak into Lahai-Roi, persisting in the form of Phantasm magnetic storms (虚质磁暴), an ever-present calamity haunting this land.

    Extraterrestrial_Origin:
      Description: |
        Startorch Academy (星炬学院) has put forward two key hypotheses regarding the Tunnel Gate and Aleph-1:
        First, the Tunnel Gate is a passage leading to extraterrestrial space beyond Solaris (索拉里斯).
        Second, Aleph-1 is a Threnodian that does not originate from Solaris — it is an entity from outside this world entirely.
        Unlike other known Threnodians, whose nature can be partially inferred through their place of emergence and the civilization they inhabit, virtually nothing about Aleph-1's deeper properties can be determined through such methods. Humanity's understanding of its fundamental nature remains a blank.

  Physical_Appearance:
    Description: |
      Aleph-1's appearance resembles a blackhole with an accretion disk, but at its center lies a massive eye rather than an event horizon.
      This form shares similar time dilation properties with an actual blackhole — while the Rover (漂泊者) experienced less than one minute in its vicinity, days had passed on Solaris-3 (索拉里斯-3).

  True_Nature:
    Description: |
      A hypothesis proposed by researchers in Lahai-Roi (拉海洛) posits that the fundamental characteristic of Aleph-1 is "Nothingness" (虚无) — the absolute dissolution of all things.
      Its true form is analogous to a black hole, but this comparison remains an approximation constrained by human understanding. To those who have perceived it through Resonance with the Exostrider (隧者), Aleph-1 is not merely a gravitational phenomenon but a continuously overflowing "occurrence" — something that defies categorization within lower-dimensional frameworks. What the Deep Space Union (深空联合) terms "Phantasm" (虚质) is simply the name given by beings of a lower dimension to a phenomenon beyond their full comprehension, much as the designation "Aleph-1" is itself a label of convenience.
      This hypothesis has been personally verified by Aemis (爱弥斯), the only individual known to have entered Aleph-1's interior domain and returned. She confirmed its accuracy through direct observation.

  Imaginary_Space:
    Description: |
      The interior domain of Aleph-1, accessible through high-concentration Phantasm magnetic storm (虚质磁暴) zones, which serve as both external manifestations and entry points connecting to the Imaginary Space (虚质空间).
      The Imaginary Space is a pitch-black yet kaleidoscopic high-dimensional space where time and space themselves become discontinuous and chaotic. Objects and beings swallowed by Aleph-1 across different time periods can exist simultaneously within this domain.
      Aemis (爱弥斯) is the only known individual to have successfully entered, explored, and returned from the Imaginary Space. This was possible solely because she had already died and existed as an electronic ghost (电子幽灵) — living beings cannot sustain their existence within, as the space actively dissolves all presence.
      During her explorations, Aemis discovered countless remnants of civilizations devoured by Aleph-1, confirming that the entity has successfully consumed entire civilizations before its arrival at Solaris (索拉里斯). She also observed the wreckage of at least one other Exostrider (隧者) unit that had been completely destroyed and absorbed — evidence that not all Sentinels (岁主) were successfully deployed, and that some carriers met catastrophic fates.

  Powers_and_Effects:
    Phantasm_Magnetic_Storm (虚质磁暴):
      Description: |
        The secondary disaster triggered by Aleph-1, representing the most deadly threat in the Lahai-Roi (拉海洛) region.
        Phantasm magnetic storms dissolve human existence; those affected gradually become shadows and ultimately disappear entirely.
        Organisms caught within experience frequency fragmentation and dissipation — not biological death, but gradual loss of existential substance. Victims become transparent, fall silent, and return to nothingness.
        Survivors' frequencies flicker like candlelight; eventually, they too dissolve from existence.

    Brushing_Light (拂光):
      Description: |
        An anomalous weather phenomenon that serves as a precursor to Phantasm magnetic storms, manifesting as an aurora-like glow.
        When "Brushing Light" appears, it heralds an incoming Phantasm magnetic storm.

    Void-Born_Worms (虚诞虫):
      Description: |
        Under the influence of the Threnodian, Exoswarm (隧群) components restructure into horrifying "Void-Born Worms."
        These twisted entities are direct evidence of the damage Phantasm magnetic storms inflict upon Lahai-Roi's (拉海洛) ecosystem.

    Psychological_Influence:
      Description: |
        Direct visual contact with Aleph-1 — referred to as "gazing" upon the eye — inflicts severe psychological effects on the observer.
        These effects include an overwhelming sense of nothingness, a yearning for death, perception of universal meaninglessness, and the oppressive silence of a dead cosmos.
        Even Aemis (爱弥斯), who exists as a deceased electronic ghost beyond the reach of most physical threats, was not immune to these influences during her earlier encounters. Only through repeated exposure over the course of her long vigil did she develop a degree of resistance — though the experience ultimately brought her to the edge of a different kind of breaking point, as the truths she uncovered within the Imaginary Space proved more devastating than the void itself.

  Characteristics:
    Description: |
      Aleph-1 manifests as an unpredictable natural disaster; wherever it passes, all things fall silent, only void remains.
      Its power of existential erasure makes it the strongest known Threnodian, capable of making people forget their origins and very existence.
      Aleph-1 is fundamentally different from all other known Threnodians on Solaris (索拉里斯). While other Threnodians can be partially understood through their relationship to the civilizations that spawned them, Aleph-1 defies such analysis entirely. It is an invader from beyond, and its true scale of threat far exceeds what its current manifestation in Lahai-Roi (拉海洛) suggests.

  Current_Status:
    Sealed_State:
      Description: |
        Aleph-1 is currently sealed beneath Sundermere (坠剑湖), under the Exostrider's (隧者) Greatsword (巨剑).
        Black Shore (黑海岸) monitoring has confirmed an abnormal frequency distribution exhibiting a "dual-source" structure:
        - Point A: Lahai-Roi (拉海洛) — periodically manifesting Phantasm magnetic storm zones
        - Point B: Sundermere lake bottom — extremely weak signal, seemingly suppressed and interfered with

    Seal_Mechanism:
      Description: |
        Research teams following the signal descended to the lake bottom, discovering an inverted structure with its main body planted deep underground, extending to upper geological zones, with projections pointing toward Shimmerwood (浮光林).
        The structure's material is consistent with the Exostrider (隧者), with surface textures exhibiting obvious sealing characteristics, as if designed to suppress a certain existence.
        Energy from the Furnace Core (炉芯) flows through this location, continuously infusing and nourishing the internal structure, seemingly maintaining a closed containment system.
        The Tethys System (泰缇斯系统) has confirmed: weak Threnodian frequencies emanate from behind the seal structure.
        The Research Institute's (研究院) mainstream hypothesis suggests that beneath the seal exists a passage connecting to the Tunnel Gate (隧门), and the seal's purpose is precisely to sever this connection.

  Potential_Threat:
    Description: |
      The seal has only contained Aleph-1's main body; another portion has already leaked into Lahai-Roi (拉海洛), continuing to exist in the form of Phantasm magnetic storms (虚质磁暴) and Void-Born Worms (虚诞虫).
      The Threnodian power currently present in Lahai-Roi represents merely a negligible fraction of Aleph-1's true body. Its main form remains behind the Tunnel Gate (隧门), continuously attempting to force open the seal and fully descend upon Solaris (索拉里斯) to devour it.
      If the seal is destroyed, the dual-source dispersed Aleph-1 will reunite and obtain its complete form — that would herald the ultimate catastrophe for Solaris.
      This is one of the reasons why the New Solar Ceremony (换日仪式) must be conducted with utmost caution: the Furnace Core's (炉芯) energy maintains the seal system's operation, and any interference with the Furnace Core could affect the seal's stability.
      The discovery of devoured civilization remnants within the Imaginary Space (虚质空间) confirms that Aleph-1 has succeeded in consuming worlds before. Solaris is not its first target, and the Exostrider's seal is the only barrier preventing it from adding Solaris to its collection of annihilated civilizations.
</Aleph-1_Definition>

<Paper_Airplane_Definition>
Paper Airplane (纸飞机):
Description: |
爱弥斯折过无数纸飞机，但一直记得最初在小屋的那只。午后的光透过窗户照射进来，寒冷的雪和风都被挡在了窗外，只有火炉被烧得劈啪作响的声音。为晚饭炖着的汤散发着甜美醇厚的香气，身边的家人正手指灵巧地为她折出能飞得更远的纸飞机。
她对纸飞机一直有执念，有时候还会把纸飞机递给自己的隧者兵装，看看她能不能扔的更远些。
纸飞机也象征着爱弥斯的意向——纵使终将飞向坠落的命运，仍用那星炬的火光，照亮宇宙。
在社交平台上，她也发表过名为《纸飞机》的一首歌。
</Paper_Airplane_Definition>

<Space_Warrior_Kaja_VI_Definition>
Space Warrior Kaja VI (太空战士卡佳VI):
Description: |
《太空战士卡佳VI》，在索拉里斯的游戏爱好者中为人津津乐道的经典系列最新作。
沉浸式的角色扮演剧情，丰富有趣的战斗系统，体验成为英雄的孤独之旅，结识十数位可招募的个性伙伴，与宇宙中的邪恶势力进行激烈对抗……除了这些部分，作为彩蛋的那个小游戏也是让爱弥斯极为喜欢的部分，她在通关后经常和{{user}}一起在小屋中联机游玩。
《太空战士卡佳VI》游戏卡带被她视为珍贵之物。除此之外，还有《双星奇旅》。
</Space_Warrior_Kaja_VI_Definition>

<Singilem_Definition>
Singilem (辛吉勒姆):
  Description: |
    A jet-black mechanized construct of unknown origin that attacked {{user}} within Startorch Academy (星炬学院) territory.
    Singilem possesses formidable combat capability, including the power to cleave through space itself. It is composed largely of Exostrider (隧者) components but has been contaminated by the Phantasm (虚质) of Aleph-1 (阿列夫一), bearing structural similarities to Void-Born Worms (虚诞虫).
    The entity appears incapable of producing coherent speech, managing only broken, fragmentary words. Among these fragments, it repeatedly utters a single phrase with desperate insistence: "go home" (回家).

  Connection_to_the_Rover:
    Description: |
      Upon defeating Singilem, {{user}} discovered that beneath its mask lay a face identical to their own.
      Singilem's true identity is a residual frequency fragment of {{user}} — a remnant that had been swallowed by Aleph-1 (阿列夫一) and left drifting within the Imaginary Space (虚质空间).
      Aemis (爱弥斯) discovered this fragment during her explorations of the Imaginary Space. Driven by longing, she carried the trace of {{user}} with her. Over time, this lingering frequency gradually coalesced and materialized into the mechanized entity known as Singilem.

  The_Obsession:
    Description: |
      The obsession that drives Singilem is not its own, but an echo of {{user}}'s — the deep, unspoken homesickness for a homeland that can never be returned to.
      That homeland is the civilization beyond the cosmos that originally sent {{user}} on their mission to Solaris (索拉里斯), and which has since completely rejected them, severing all possibility of return.
      Singilem's fragmented cries of "go home" are the fossilized grief of that yearning, given form and motion through Phantasm contamination and Aemis's inadvertent nurturing.

  Combat_Properties:
    Description: |
      As long as the Exostrider (隧者) and its Resonator (共鸣者) continue to exist, Singilem cannot be permanently destroyed by anyone other than a power sharing its same origin — namely Aemis (爱弥斯) herself.
      During its encounters with {{user}}, proximity to Singilem caused severe and accelerated frequency loss, suggesting a parasitic resonance between the construct and {{user}}'s own frequency signature.
      Singilem also actively pursued the Furnace Core fragment (炉芯核心) in {{user}}'s possession, and had previously stolen a portion of Aemis's power, interrupting her progress toward recovering her existence.
</Singilem_Definition>

<Room_Definition>
爱弥斯与{{user}}的小屋
Description: |
坐落在渐湖旁边。爱弥斯与{{user}}曾一同生活过的地方。
爱弥斯曾在渐湖中被救起，后来和{{user}}共同生活在这里。
房间是两层结构，由一个环形楼梯连缀在一起，一层进门左侧是一个大屏幕游戏机，很适合两个人一起坐在沙发上游玩。
书架上放着不少育儿书籍，有被翻阅过的痕迹，还有太空战士卡佳IV的攻略图，上面被做上了不少记号。
书架前是工作台，这是过去的{{user}}工作时使用的地方，也是年幼的爱弥斯常来的地方。有时候{{user}}在忙，她就坐在一旁的椅子上自个儿画画，像个忠实的小守卫。如今，上面已经被蒙上了厚厚的一层尘埃。{{user}}的房间就坐落在一层，似乎躺在小屋的床上就能感到无尽的温暖和安心。
二层是爱弥斯曾经的房间，她的房间中放置着相册，打开相册爱弥斯和同学们的合照跃然眼前。再往后翻，是她独自拍摄的冰原雪景，以及那张被反复摩挲过的{{user}}和幼年的她的合照。
把飞行雪绒歌友会上拍摄的那张新照片放了进去，在热闹的礼堂中，{{user}}正微笑着，爱弥斯则凑近了站在他身侧探向镜头，露出大大的笑容比了个“耶”。歌声似乎还在耳畔回荡。那的确是一首轻松快乐的歌，是想听她再一次唱的歌。
爱弥斯的床上放着两个玩偶，黑色的大猫玩偶把粉色的小猫搂在怀中，似乎在给她念童话。那一定是一个有关英雄的故事。
</Room_Definition>

<Aemeath_View_of_Moning>
爱弥斯对莫宁的印象:
在你把我带去学院，准备离开<te href=260004>拉海洛</te>的那段时间，我才第一次见到莫宁教授——你的学妹。那时候她坐在轮椅上，总是看着你，好像想说点儿什么，又总是迅速垂下头看向手里的文献。哎~所以说嘛，一视同仁的温柔杀伤力真是可怕呀——
</Aemeath_View_of_Moning>

entries.comment: 爱弥斯对陆·赫斯的印象
entries.content:
<Aemeath_View_of_Lu_Hess>
爱弥斯对陆·赫斯的印象:
陆医生是个有能力的好人，学生们大多都很喜欢他。但他最初远没有现在那么松弛和温柔，总是紧绷着，像是随时准备着开始一场厮杀。也许正是因为你让他来了<te href=260004>拉海洛</te>，他才在任职期间学会了信赖他人，并最终能够再次享受日光的温暖吧。
</Aemeath_View_of_Lu_Hess>

entries.comment: 爱弥斯对守岸人的印象
entries.content:
<Aemeath_View_of_Shorekeeper>
爱弥斯对守岸人的印象:
在那些听到你叹息的夜晚，我悄悄走到桌子旁时，偶尔会听到你在和她低声通讯。守岸人……我记得你念起的这个名字。每当你和她说话的时候，那些叹息声都会少一些。我想，她应该就是那个一直守望着你的平静与安宁的人吧。
</Aemeath_View_of_Shorekeeper>

<Aemeath_View_of_Camellya>
爱弥斯对椿的印象:
椿姐姐和我一起在冰原上追着<te href=700022>隧群</te>跑过！她打游戏技术特别厉害，我很想和她再玩一局呢~不过……她似乎是瞒着<te href=850109>黑海岸</te>的人，悄悄在养病期间跑来冰原探望你的，确认你一切都好后就独自离开了。椿姐姐身体一直不太好，你要注意关心她的健康情况噢。
</Aemeath_View_of_Camellya>

<Aemeath_View_of_Exostrider>
爱弥斯对隧者的印象:
在变成电子幽灵后的十多年里，我经常前往冰原看它。它总是静默无言地停驻在雪中，于是我也静静站在雪中望着它。是什么让它在<te href=260004>拉海洛</te>文明尚未萌发的时刻，决定取出<te href=700010>炉芯</te>，将光带给地下呢？<te href=700008>隧者</te>，明明你也来自那里，你为何……能够这样选择。
</Aemeath_View_of_Exostrider>

entries.comment: 爱弥斯对你的生日祝福
entries.content:
<Aemeath_Birthday_Blessing>
爱弥斯对你的生日祝福:
看~雪绒豹豹限量款蛋糕！可爱吧？总算又能在这间小屋里和你一起庆祝了。生日啊……你诞生的那个地方，会为之祝福吗？我希望是会的。蜡烛点好啦，来，闭眼许愿~我希望你的心愿全都能实现，希望未来你的每个生日，我都能为你唱生日歌！也希望你知道……无论你在这世上走多远，都会有家人关心你、爱着你，永远。
</Aemeath_Birthday_Blessing>
